definitions.gloss: shoe blister; chafing from shoes; shoe sore
definitions.explanation: A blister, sore, or abrasion on the foot caused by friction from ill-fitting or new shoes. A common problem when breaking in new footwear.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{靴|くつ}→靴：00725_kutsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{靴擦|くつず}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: I got a blister from my new shoes.

examples.japanese: {靴擦|くつず}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}くて→痛い：01108_itai⟧⟦{歩|ある}けない→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
examples.english: The shoe blister hurts so much that I can't walk.

examples.japanese: {靴擦|くつず}れ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{靴|くつ}→靴：00725_kutsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦ずつ→〜ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧⟦{履|は}き→履く：00700_haku⟧⟦{慣|な}らした→慣らす：02390_narasu⟧⟦{方|ほう}→方：01139_hou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: To prevent blisters, it's better to gradually break in new shoes.

notes:
USAGE:
A very practical, everyday word. Most commonly occurs with ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{靴|くつ}→靴：00725_kutsu⟧ (new shoes) or ⟦{革靴|かわぐつ}→革靴：15433_kawagutsu⟧ (leather shoes). Blisters typically form on the heel or sides of the foot.

FORMS:
⟦{靴|くつ}→靴：00725_kutsu⟧ (shoes) + {擦|ず}れ (rubbing, chafing — from the verb ⟦{擦|す}れる→擦れる：28852_sureru⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {靴擦|くつず}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧ (to get a shoe blister)
- {靴擦|くつず}れ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧ (to prevent shoe blisters)
- {靴擦|くつず}れ⟦{防止|ぼうし}→防止：14571_boushi⟧パッド (blister prevention pad)
- ⟦{靴|くつ}→靴：00725_kutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{履|は}き→履く：00700_haku⟧⟦{慣|な}らす→慣らす：02390_narasu⟧ (to break in shoes)
